dedupe_keys.name: a simulation based platform to design high performance buildings that use phase change materials

description: Facundo Bre and Eduardus Koenders document a computational design method coupling whole-building EnergyPlus simulations with multi-objective optimisation. Starting from an EnergyPlus building model, the described workflow generates parametric phase-change material models and varies melting temperature and thickness. It can also include insulation, window-to-wall ratio and external shading to compare heating and cooling trade-offs. This record represents the documented modelling method; the abstract’s platform label does not establish an obtainable software framework. Zenodo supplies the conference paper freely under CC BY 4.0. Separate code access and licensing are unknown. Coverage is a generic building-design workflow. Related deposits publish particular PCM optimisation models and results. A limitation is that the inspected metadata does not specify the full algorithm, interfaces, runtime or validation tests. No paper body, software or model output was downloaded.
